findings.text: The specification assumes any trigger makes an INSERT a multi-row write, but SQLite 3.51.0 permits a single-row parent insert with a malformed referenced key when its only trigger is an UPDATE trigger. Fix: specify an applicable INSERT trigger.

The specification excludes rowid replacement without a UNIQUE index, but SQLite 3.51.0 rejects `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO p VALUES(1,2)` for `p(a INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,b)` referenced by `c(x REFERENCES p(b))`. Fix: include the rowid REPLACE paths that set `isMultiWrite` in `sqlite3GenerateConstraintChecks`.
